answer: Practically, the chain should let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because terrace only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, atlas is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any grove approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
